title: The First Episode About Banda Bahadur

blocks.text: The Guru honors the mahant Jait Ram, recognizes him as a worthy saint, and hears his humble request to serve the sangat and keep devotional company around him.

When the Guru raises the question of meat-eating among many of his followers, Jait Ram answers that under the sanctity of Dadu’s house they will accept even simple fare together and remain in fellowship.
This reception closes one encounter and opens the next, with Jait Ram becoming the bridge toward the coming account of Banda and the Guru’s onward movement.
